name: x3d-stem-vortex-sound/v1
purpose: Vortex Reconnection & Sound (x3d.STEM flagship 6). Accepting under it means: the scene is grammatical and meaningful on the fork with no known trap; both cases declare model and limits; small waves follow the exact Bogoliubov dispersion at second order in dt; the norm is conserved to rounding and the energy drift is bounded; a ring's speed is stable between grids and agrees with Roberts-Grant plus the measured periodic-box term (grade L); the collision is called a reconnection only because the vortex-loop sequence and event times agree on two grids (the Scientific Loom's open topology gate), and the sound energy rises after it; payloads inflate to their recorded bytes; the builder and solver are the shipped ones; and a browser meshed every frame's vortex cores and matched the builder.
limitations: Page traps are static pattern and syntax checks of src/*.js against the X_ITE contracts the Loom has paid for (law 32); the page's browser evidence remains the behaviour witness.
Behaviour is one headless Chromium on one machine: mesh counts, volumes and playback order, not pixels or frame rate.
The ring-speed witness is grade L: a large-ring asymptote plus a box term measured in exploration.
The strand-separation scaling near reconnection is reported, not gated (not robust at this resolution).
The shared library lib/stemkit lies outside the candidate; its hashes are recorded but not gated.
Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout, not the family pin.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
